about: Whether an arrival fires a listen, by its plan's filters. Each plan is the checker's answer for its listen's source against `catalog` (both runners check that it still is). Only hops judged on arrival are judged, each against the record the arrival carries for it: `landing` for the last hop, `parents` (aligned to the plan's `carries`) for earlier ones. Each record states its `recordType`, which must be the record type its hop lands on (`to`): one edge name may hang off several record types (`pay`'s Customer and Invoice each have `Changes`), and a record of another type skips at its hop, the landing judged first; a record that states none is undecided. A hop's checked part is always evaluated; its taken part too, unless `takenApplied` says the module applied it. `now` is the instant WITHIN measures from. The verdict is `{fires: true}`, `{skips: n}` (the hop whose filter fails, outermost 0; with a `reason` when the record carried for that hop is of another record type, so no filter was read), or `{undecided: reason}` (the host logs it and runs nothing). Held by listen-fire's Rust (crates/movement-engine/src/listen_judge.rs, judge_arrival), the engine's TypeScript (judgeArrival, through the wasm) and the hosted product. A read on through a record a field holds (`c.Current.Stage`) reads that field of the landing, then the member of what it holds; a record absent reads its members absent. A record may name the fields its module could not read (`unknown`): a conjunct reading one is undecided, whatever `fields` holds for it, never read as absent; a hop that fails still decides.

cases.case: a press on a lunch poll fires
a press on a poll older than 3d skips at Messages
a change of another kind skips at Changes
a press carrying no message is undecided

verdict.undecided: the arrival carries no Messages record, which this listen's filter on it reads

cases.case: a press carrying null for its message is undecided

verdict.undecided: the arrival carries no Messages record, which this listen's filter on it reads

cases.case: a pushed press its module did not filter, in another channel, skips at Channels
the same press fires when its module applied the taken parts
a press on another topic its module did not filter skips at Messages
a press its module filtered is still checked: an old poll skips at Messages
a later hop that fails decides over a parent the arrival lacks
an arrival on another edge skips at the last hop
a created change fires: the hops the host resolves are not judged here
a press whose value is its message's topic fires
a press whose value is not its message's topic skips at Interactions
a press whose filter reads a message it does not carry is undecided

verdict.undecided: the arrival carries no Messages record, which this listen's filter on it reads

cases.case: an unfiltered mail whose taken part reads an owned field is undecided

verdict.undecided: gmail did not apply this listen's filter on Messages to the arrival, and only gmail can evaluate Query

cases.case: an unfiltered arrival that carries the owned field is judged by the value it carries as text, and fires
an unfiltered arrival that carries another value of the owned field skips
an unfiltered arrival that carries the empty value of the owned field carries it, and skips a listen naming another
a mail its module filtered on the owned field fires on the checked part
an unfiltered mail that fails the checked part skips, though the owned part is undecided
a press scoring 5 fires: its negation is below 1
a press scoring -2 skips at Interactions: its negation is not below 1
a folder in a folder, each read from its own record, fires
a folder in another folder skips at the inner Folders hop, not the first
the same two folders in the opposite order skip at the outer Folders hop
a star whose carries are not in hop order, one a hop it does not take, fires
a star in another channel skips at Channels, read from the third carried record
a star on another topic skips at Messages, read from the first carried record
a null in the slot of a carried edge that is no hop changes nothing
a star that stops short of the channel record is undecided on Channels

verdict.undecided: the arrival carries no Channels record, which this listen's filter on it reads

cases.case: a poll posted a day before an instant in 2020 is within 3d of it
a poll posted a week before an instant in 2020 is not, and skips at Messages
a customer's created change fires the listen on a customer's Changes
an invoice's created change, on an edge of the same name, skips at the customer's Changes

verdict.reason: it has record type InvoiceChange, not CustomerChange, which this listen's Changes lands on

cases.case: a customer's change carrying a parent of another record type skips at Customers

verdict.reason: the Customers record it carries has record type Invoice, not Customer, which this listen's Customers lands on

cases.case: a landing of another record type skips although its fields pass every WHERE

verdict.reason: it has record type InvoiceChange, not CustomerChange, which this listen's Changes lands on

cases.case: a change that does not say its record type is undecided

verdict.undecided: the arrival pay reported on Changes does not say its record type, so it cannot be told from another record type's Changes (this listen's lands on CustomerChange)

cases.case: a change whose carried customer does not say its record type is undecided

verdict.undecided: the arrival pay reported on Changes carries a Customers record that does not say its record type (this listen's Customers lands on Customer)

cases.case: an untyped change that fails a WHERE still skips
a row moved from Applied to Interview fires the listen reading through the rows a change holds; the Candidates change lands as the table's un-narrowed Change
a row created at Interview fires: it held nothing before
a row edited while it stays at Interview does not
a row moved to Rejected does not
a row deleted holds nothing now, and does not
a field whose name holds a dot is not a read through a held row
a press whose channel name its module could not read is undecided, never skipped

verdict.undecided: chat could not read Name of the Channels record the arrival carries, which this listen's filter reads

cases.case: a value a field holds is not read when its module says it could not read the field

verdict.undecided: chat could not read Name of the Channels record the arrival carries, which this listen's filter reads

cases.case: a field its module could not read that no filter reads changes nothing
a press whose own value its module could not read is undecided at Interactions

verdict.undecided: chat could not read Value of the arrival on Interactions, which this listen's filter reads

cases.case: a hop that fails decides over a field its module could not read
a read through a held row its module could not read is undecided

verdict.undecided: rows could not read Previous of the arrival on Changes, which this listen's filter reads
